questionText: According to **Mendelow's Stakeholder Mapping Matrix**, how should management engage with a stakeholder group that possesses **High Power** over the organization but currently demonstrates **Low Interest** in its day-to-day strategies?

options.text: Keep Satisfied — address their core concerns so they do not shift into active opposition
Key Players — involve them directly in all operational governance decisions
Keep Informed — provide regular newsletters and transparency reports
Minimal Effort — monitor passively with minimal resource allocation

questionText: Which of the following is a primary statutory distinction between a **Public Listed Company** and a **Private Limited Company** in Pakistan?

options.text: A private limited company restricts the right to transfer its shares and prohibits invitations to the general public to subscribe for shares
Shareholders of a private limited company have unlimited personal liability for corporate debts
A private limited company cannot enter into contracts in its own corporate name
A public listed company is exempt from appointing an external statutory auditor

questionText: In **Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory** of work motivation, which of the following pairs consists exclusively of **Motivator (Growth) Factors** rather than Hygiene (Maintenance) Factors?

options.text: Sense of achievement and intrinsic responsibility for the work itself
Competitive base salary and job security
Safe physical working conditions and supportive company policies
Quality of technical supervision and interpersonal peer relations

questionText: A global engineering consultancy organizes its staff by functional specialties (Tax, Audit, Advisory) while simultaneously assigning them to temporary cross-functional industry project teams (Energy, Banking, Telecom). What organizational structure is being used, and which classic management principle does it intentionally relax?

options.text: Matrix structure; relaxes Fayol's principle of Unity of Command (dual reporting)
Divisional structure; eliminates functional specialization altogether
Entrepreneurial structure; centralizes all decisions in a single founder
Bureaucratic pyramid; enforces a narrow span of control of 1:1

questionText: Within the **Anthony Hierarchy of Information Systems**, which system specifically aggregates internal Transaction Processing System (TPS) data into periodic exception reports, variance summaries, and budget comparisons for **middle management**?

options.text: Management Information System (MIS)
Executive Information System (EIS)
Expert Knowledge System (EKS)
Operational Batch Ledger (OBL)

questionText: A newly qualified Chartered Accountant is asked by the Finance Director to delay recording a major inventory write-down until next quarter so that the executive team qualifies for their annual profit bonus. Under the **ICAP Code of Ethics (IESBA Code)**, which two fundamental threats are simultaneously created?

options.text: Intimidation threat and Self-interest threat
Advocacy threat and Familiarity threat
Self-review threat and Advocacy threat
Familiarity threat and Self-review threat
